sources.entry: Build a React Native Todo Application

summary.title: Build a React Native Todo Application
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a basic todo app for iOS and Android with React Native, covering components, Flexbox layout, styling, state, AsyncStorage persistence, and inline editing in a ListView.
takeaways: Build a simple React Native todo application that runs on both iOS and Android.
Create custom React Native components and use built-in components.
Lay out and style an app with Flexbox.
Control components with state and persist data across reloads using AsyncStorage.
Implement inline editing in a ListView.
summary.summary: This is a 13-lesson, 44-minute egghead.io course on building a basic React Native todo application for iOS and Android. It covers React Native components, building custom components, Flexbox layout, and styling. It also shows how to use state to control components, persist information across app reloads with AsyncStorage, and inline edit items in a ListView. The stated goal is a foundational understanding of building simple React Native apps.
